title: Certificate and paper for: Goldbach-type sums a+b=N with Omega(ab) <= 32
description: Code, outputs and SHA-256 manifest of the rigorous (ball-arithmetic) finite-range certificate, together with the preprint, for the result that every integer N >= 2 can be written as N = a + b with positive integers a, b and Omega(ab) <= 32. This improves the bound Omega(ab) <= 33 of P. J. Campbell (arXiv:2608.09488).
